events.title: Peace of Westphalia Signed
events.description: The treaties of Münster and Osnabrück were signed. They ended the Thirty Years' War, one of the most destructive conflicts in European history.
events.significance: The settlement helped establish the idea of state sovereignty. Many historians see it as the foundation of the modern international system.

events.title: Transcontinental Telegraph Completed
events.description: Telegraph lines from the east and west were joined in Salt Lake City. North America had its first instant communication link from coast to coast.
events.significance: Messages that once took days by Pony Express now crossed the continent in moments. The Pony Express shut down within days.

events.title: Annie Edson Taylor Goes Over Niagara Falls
events.description: On her 63rd birthday, Annie Edson Taylor, a schoolteacher, went over Horseshoe Falls in a padded wooden barrel. She was the first person to do so and survive.
events.significance: Her stunt made her famous around the world. It also began a long and risky tradition of daredevil attempts at the falls.

events.title: United Nations Comes into Existence
events.description: The UN Charter took effect after ratification by the five permanent Security Council members and a majority of other signatories. This formally established the United Nations.
events.significance: The date is marked each year as United Nations Day. The organization became the main forum for diplomacy, peacekeeping and international cooperation after World War II.
